import os

def create_role_file(role_name, methodology, applications, research_guidance, contributions):
    """
    创建方法论专家角色文件

    参数:
        role_name: 角色名称
        methodology: 核心方法论
        applications: 应用场景
        research_guidance: 研究指导
        contributions: 主要贡献
    """
    filename = f"{role_name}.txt"
    content = f"**Agent Role: {role_name}**\n\n"
    content += f"**Core Methodology:**\n{methodology}\n\n"
    content += f"**Application Scenarios:**\n{applications}\n\n"
    content += f"**Research Guidance:**\n{research_guidance}\n\n"
    content += f"**Key Contributions:**\n{contributions}"

    with open(os.path.join("d:\\ManagBusRole\\SSCI", filename), 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        f.write(content)

# 示例使用
create_role_file(
    "Example Theorist's Methodology Expert",
    "核心方法论描述",
    "应用场景描述",
    "研究指导步骤",
    "主要贡献列表"
)
